$comment: Sprint 1 test cases, written from the acceptance criteria. Course template columns. Fill 'actual' and 'result' only from real test runs. 'automated' names the test file that covers the case, once it exists.

cases.scenario: First sign-in with a verified IBA Microsoft account creates the account and opens profile setup (US1.1)
cases.pre: Microsoft account on khi.iba.edu.pk; no IBA Connect account yet
steps: Sign in at Microsoft and accept
cases.expected: Signed in, account created, redirected to profile setup

cases.scenario: Microsoft account outside the IBA domain is refused (US1.1, NFR8)
cases.expected: Access refused with a clear message; no member record is created

cases.scenario: Returning member with a finished profile goes straight to the dashboard
cases.pre: Member signed up with Microsoft and finished profile setup
cases.expected: Dashboard opens

cases.scenario: Register with email and password; a verification email is sent (US1.2)
steps: Fill in name, email, password and confirmation
cases.expected: Message asks to check email; verification email arrives

cases.scenario: Weak password is rejected
cases.expected: Error explains the password rules; no account created

cases.scenario: Unverified account cannot use the platform (US1.2)
cases.expected: Asked to verify email first; dashboard not shown

cases.scenario: Verification link verifies the account and opens profile setup
steps: Click the link in the verification email
cases.expected: Email verified; profile setup opens

cases.scenario: Wrong password is refused
steps: Enter the email and a wrong password
cases.expected: "Incorrect email or password"; not signed in

cases.scenario: Repeated failed sign-ins are rate-limited (NFR20)
steps: Submit a wrong password 11 times within 15 minutes
cases.expected: 11th attempt refused with "Too many attempts" and a wait time

cases.scenario: Passwords are stored as bcrypt hashes (US1.2, NFR6)
steps: Inspect the account's stored password in Supabase Auth
cases.expected: Only a bcrypt hash ($2a$/$2b$) is stored, never the plain password

cases.scenario: Forgot password sends a reset email (US1.3)
cases.expected: Confirmation shown; reset email arrives

cases.scenario: Reset link sets a new password that works for sign-in
steps: Enter and confirm a new password
Sign in with the new password
cases.expected: Password changed; sign-in with the new password succeeds and the old one fails

cases.scenario: Signed-in member changes their password (US1.3)
cases.expected: Saved; later sign-ins use the new password

cases.scenario: Mismatched confirmation is rejected
cases.expected: Error "Passwords do not match"; password unchanged

cases.scenario: Valid administration code verifies an alumnus (US1.4)
cases.pre: Admin issued an active code; alumnus registered with a personal email
cases.expected: Account verified as alumnus; code marked as claimed

cases.scenario: Personal email on the alumni list verifies an alumnus
cases.pre: Email is on the uploaded alumni list
cases.expected: Account verified as alumnus

cases.scenario: Invalid, expired or revoked code is refused
cases.expected: Verification refused; no alumnus access

cases.scenario: Code already claimed by someone else is refused
cases.expected: Verification refused

cases.scenario: Profile setup with all required fields (US1.5)
steps: Fill in name, batch, programme, department, semester, bio and at least one skill
cases.expected: Profile saved; member appears in the directory; dashboard opens

cases.scenario: Profile cannot be finished without a required field
cases.expected: Error on the skills field; profile not finished

cases.scenario: Bio longer than 500 characters is rejected
cases.expected: Error shows the 500-character limit; nothing saved

cases.scenario: Edited profile appears on the profile and in search (US1.6)
steps: Change bio and add a skill
cases.expected: Changes on the profile page and in search results

cases.scenario: Image avatar is uploaded and shown (US1.6)
cases.expected: Avatar shown on profile and directory card

cases.scenario: Non-image avatar is rejected (US1.6)
cases.expected: Error "Only image files"; avatar unchanged

cases.scenario: Alumnus adds field and company (US1.7)
cases.expected: Shown on profile; usable as alumni filters

cases.scenario: Turning advising on with courses shows the badge (US1.8)
cases.expected: Badge on profile and search results; matches the advise filter for CSE341

cases.scenario: Turning advising off removes the badge (US1.8)
cases.expected: Badge removed; no longer matches the advise filter

cases.scenario: Sign out ends the session
cases.expected: Sign-in page shown; dashboard needs sign-in again

cases.scenario: Signed-out visitor cannot open member pages
cases.expected: Pages redirect to /sign-in; API returns 401

cases.scenario: Suspended member is signed out on the next request
cases.pre: Member signed in; admin sets status to suspended
cases.expected: Signed out with a message that the account is suspended

cases.scenario: Idle session expires
cases.pre: Signed in; idle longer than the session limit in the test plan
steps: Open any page after the idle period
cases.expected: Asked to sign in again

cases.scenario: Dashboard shows pending requests, unread messages, open posts and shortcuts
cases.pre: Member with 2 pending requests, 1 unread message, 1 open post
cases.expected: Counts 2, 1 and 1 shown with links to each list

cases.scenario: Every main screen is within three clicks of the dashboard (NFR14)
steps: From the dashboard, open Directory, Need Board, Messages, Requests, Settings and Profile, counting clicks
cases.expected: Each screen reached in three clicks or fewer

cases.scenario: Deactivated profile leaves the directory
steps: Search for the member from another account
cases.expected: Signed out; member no longer appears in the directory

cases.scenario: Deleted account is removed and its messages anonymised
cases.pre: Member with an accepted connection and messages
steps: Open the old chat from the other account
cases.expected: Account removed; messages show "Deleted member"; cannot sign in

cases.scenario: Cancelling the confirmation changes nothing
cases.expected: Account unchanged

cases.scenario: Admin creates an alumni code
steps: Click New code, set an expiry
cases.expected: Code listed as active; audit log entry added

cases.scenario: Revoked code can no longer be used
cases.expected: Code shown as revoked; verification refused

cases.scenario: Admin uploads the alumni list
steps: Upload a CSV with email, name and batch
cases.expected: 3 entries stored; duplicates skipped and reported

cases.scenario: Non-admin cannot open the admin panel (FR8.5)
cases.expected: Page refused; API returns 403

cases.scenario: Admin adds a course
cases.expected: Course offered in profile and post pickers

cases.scenario: Retired course is no longer offered but stays on existing profiles
cases.expected: Not in the picker; still on the existing profile

cases.scenario: Duplicate course code is rejected
steps: Add a course with code CSE341
cases.expected: Error "Course code already exists"

cases.scenario: Paginated directory with links to profiles (US2.1)
cases.expected: Members listed page by page; the member's profile opens

cases.scenario: No contact details in the directory or on unconnected profiles (US2.1, US2.6, NFR10)
cases.pre: Signed in; not connected to the member
cases.expected: No email anywhere in the page or API response

cases.scenario: Profile page shows the profile details (US2.6)
cases.expected: Name, batch, programme, department, bio, skills, courses and advise badge shown

cases.scenario: Search by skill (US2.2)
cases.expected: Only members with the Python skill (or the word in their name or course)

cases.scenario: Search by course code
cases.expected: Members who listed CSE341

cases.scenario: No matches shows an empty state
cases.expected: "No members found" with a way to clear the search

cases.scenario: Search responds within 2 s at the 95th percentile on 1,000 members (NFR1)
cases.expected: 95th percentile under 2 s

cases.scenario: Course plus advise filter finds advisers for that course (US2.4)
cases.expected: Only advisers who listed CSE341, each with the badge

cases.scenario: Combined filters match all of them; clearing shows everyone (US2.3)
steps: Filter batch 2023 and department Computer Science
cases.expected: Results match both filters; full directory after clearing

cases.scenario: Alumni field and company filters (US2.5)
cases.expected: Only alumni in Banking

cases.scenario: Send a request with a note (US3.1)
cases.pre: Signed in; not connected to the member
cases.expected: Pending request in Outgoing; recipient gets an email

cases.scenario: Note longer than 300 characters is rejected
cases.expected: Error shows the limit; nothing sent

cases.scenario: Daily limit blocks the 11th request (US3.2)
cases.expected: Blocked with an explanation of the daily limit

cases.scenario: Asking the same person again during the cooldown is blocked (US3.2)
cases.pre: Request to this member was declined recently
steps: Send a new request to the same member
cases.expected: Blocked; told when they can ask again

cases.scenario: Cannot request someone already pending or connected
cases.expected: Button shows "Pending"; API refuses a duplicate

cases.scenario: Accepting enables chat for both (US3.3)
cases.expected: Connection created; both members can open the chat

cases.scenario: Declining keeps chat disabled (US3.3)
cases.expected: Requester sees Declined; no chat

cases.scenario: Only the recipient can accept a request
cases.expected: Refused (403/404); request still pending

cases.scenario: Inbox switches between incoming, outgoing and accepted (US3.4)
cases.expected: Each tab lists the right requests with person, note and status

cases.scenario: Connected members exchange messages in order (US3.5)
cases.expected: Messages shown in order with times on both sides

cases.scenario: Messaging without an accepted connection is refused (US3.5)
cases.expected: Refused; no message stored

cases.scenario: Unread indicator clears when the thread is opened (US3.6)
cases.expected: Badge shown before; messages marked read and badge cleared after

cases.scenario: Email hidden before the connection is accepted (US3.7)
cases.expected: No email anywhere

cases.scenario: Email visible to both after acceptance (US3.7)
steps: Each member opens the other's profile
cases.expected: Each sees the other's email

cases.scenario: New request sends an email to the recipient
cases.expected: Email with the requester's name and a link to Requests

cases.scenario: Menu badges show unread requests and messages
cases.expected: Requests badge 1, Messages badge 2

cases.scenario: Member blocks another member
steps: As B, open A's profile and click Connect
cases.expected: Block saved; B's request is refused

cases.scenario: Blocked member's messages are refused
cases.pre: A and B connected; A blocks B
steps: As B, send a message to A
cases.expected: Message refused

cases.scenario: Message longer than 2,000 characters is rejected
cases.expected: Error shows the limit; nothing sent

cases.scenario: Empty message is not sent
steps: Send with an empty or spaces-only box
cases.expected: Send disabled or refused

cases.scenario: New messages appear without reloading
cases.pre: Both members have the chat open
cases.expected: Message appears on B's screen within the polling interval (5 s)

cases.scenario: Create a post with type, title, body and course tag (US4.1)
steps: Choose Study partner, fill title and body, tag CSE341
cases.expected: Post open on the board for all members; expires in 14 days

cases.scenario: Post without a title is rejected
cases.expected: Error on the title; not published

cases.scenario: Board shows open posts only and filters by type and tag (US4.2)
cases.pre: Open, closed and expired posts exist
steps: Filter type = Course advice and tag = CSE341
cases.expected: Only open posts; filtered list matches both

cases.scenario: Responding opens a connection request linked to the post (US4.3)
cases.expected: Pending request with the post context; the poster sees the response

cases.scenario: Responding to your own post is refused
cases.expected: Refused

cases.scenario: Request limits also apply to responses (US4.3)
cases.expected: Blocked with the daily-limit explanation

cases.scenario: Closing a post removes it from the board; responses stay visible (US4.4)
cases.pre: Own open post with a response
cases.expected: Post leaves the board; author still sees the response

cases.scenario: Post expires after 14 days (US4.5)
steps: Open My post as the author
cases.expected: Not on the board; responses visible to the author

cases.scenario: Author edits an open post
cases.expected: Changes shown on the board

cases.scenario: Cannot edit someone else's post or a closed post
cases.pre: Another member's post; own closed post
cases.expected: Both refused

cases.scenario: Primary flows work at 360 px without sideways scrolling
steps: Go through sign-in, profile, search, request, chat and post
cases.expected: Everything usable; bottom menu shown; no horizontal scroll

cases.scenario: Primary flows work with the keyboard alone, with visible focus
steps: Use Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter and Escape through sign-in, search and chat
cases.expected: Every control reachable; focus ring always visible

cases.scenario: Advising cannot be turned on without choosing a course
cases.expected: Error "Choose at least one course you can advise on"; not saved

cases.scenario: Signed-out visitor cannot see a dashboard
cases.expected: Redirected to /sign-in

cases.scenario: Invalid filter values are rejected
cases.expected: 400 with the invalid fields listed

cases.scenario: Inbox never shows other members' requests
cases.pre: Requests exist between B and C
cases.expected: None of B and C's requests appear

cases.scenario: A refused request sends no email
cases.expected: Request refused; no email sent

cases.scenario: Closed and expired posts never appear on the board, even when filtered
cases.pre: Closed and expired posts tagged CSE341
cases.expected: Only open CSE341 posts listed

cases.scenario: Only the author can close a post
cases.expected: Refused; post stays open
